##################################
# For sending e-mail using SMTP. #
##################################

# This demo has no mail server. Mail is written to the container log instead of
# being sent, so account-activation and password-reset messages can be read with
# `docker compose logs kpi` rather than silently failing.
EMAIL_BACKEND=django.core.mail.backends.console.EmailBackend
EMAIL_HOST=
EMAIL_PORT=587
EMAIL_HOST_USER=
EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD=
EMAIL_USE_TLS=True
DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL=support@kobo.local
